coordinate_definition: native targets h*r_sensor, inverted using aperture-free geometric chief at 550nm; object angles held fixed across wavelength
limitations: Ray visibility is not PSF/OTF convergence or measured-lens validation.
Finite stop/raster samplers do not certify total throughput or physical darkness.
RF16 native edge chief required independent first-surface bracketing; primary stop aiming remains incomplete.
RF16 full-frame corner remains uncalibrated; bounded search maximum is not a physical coverage bound.
